purpose: Cross-corpus early-text controls for 女X structure. Prevents the model from equating the grammatical form 女+core-name with any one cult, clan, or deity family.

cases.early_commentary: 王逸注：女歧，神女，无夫而生九子也。

cases.guard: Same surface name in the same work does not by itself prove one person or two. Preserve two occurrences and test transmission/commentary models.

cases.source: 说文解字·女部（引甘氏星经）
cases.text: 甘氏星经曰：太白上公，妻曰女媊。女媊居南斗，食厉，天下祭之，曰明星。

cases.guard: A raw 女+one-CJK regex will catch this; it must not enter a deity census.

variant_relations.evidence: Later transmission explicitly glosses 媊音前; historical source spelling remains 女媊.

model_implication: The construction 女+core graph is cross-tradition. It cannot by itself identify Wa/frog affiliation. Wa classification requires independent geography, ritual, hydrology, iconography, phonology, genealogy, or textual-provenance evidence.
